{{TierList/Item|Golden Freezo (Emperor)
|Description=Godly DPS, Ginormous AoE circle and GREAT range. Golden Freezo's huge AoE circle, resulting in huge coverage and a massive amount of enemies being hit at one time makes him one of the best units in the game currently, and truly an "emperor" in terms of his capabilities to do insane amounts of damage. Upon release, he was being compared to [[Metal Knight (Arsenal)]], which after further testing, Freezo just barely beats Metal Knight because of his 3 placements contrasting from Metal Knight only having 2, which equates to Freezo having more Group DPS and DPM. Golden Freezo's affinity combo is also really good because it is identical to [[JIO (Over Heaven)]]'s making him extremely good with the [[Relics|Miracle Timepiece]]. Traits like Nimble III, Godspeed, and curses with SPA reduction are best with this unit, as he has long SPA. (Costs {{Yen|119.75K}} to reach his maximum upgrade.)
<br />

{{TierList/Item|Hanje (Captain)
|Description=Amazing-Insane DPS, Moderate AoE Circle and Good range. Being much like her comrade, [[Levy Ackman]], she is able to make units bleed while also carrying the 50% crit chance with her, making her very destructive and efficient with her job of killing enemies. However, with Levy already having been long from the meta, Hanje replaced [[Toshin (Dragon Lotus)]] and [[King (Sloth)]], because of her 5 placement cap AND bleeding with good damage alongside crit. Truly demonstrating the role of a captain, she is the BEST bleed HILL unit in Anime Adventures in its current state! She is only obtainable from the [[Ammo Pass]]. When equipped with the [[Relics|Lostvain]] relic and the [[Relics|Nail]] relic her power spikes heavily, especially when synergies with [[Power (Fiend)]] (Costs {{Yen|43.5K}} to reach her maximum upgrade.)
<br />
DPS (Damage Per Second): 6,979
<br />

<br />

<br />
Total DPM (Group DPM): 2,093,700}}
{{TierList/Item|Hawk (Fierce Wings)
|Description=Ultimate DPS, Good AoE Circle, Great Range! Hawks is the first unit after 5+ updates to officially dethrone the former best physical hill unit, [[Soi Fan (Hornet)]], Hawks release now makes her the third best physical hill. Unfortunately, Hawk does NOT beat [[Hanje (Captain)]] as Hanje contains 50% crit, with bleed, and insane boss killing abilities! However, Hawk is still the SECOND best physical hill unit, as he has potentials to do absolutely insane damage because of his crit, multi hit, and his good AoE Circle. Combined with the power of his telekentical abilities, can be proven a viable unit in both infinite mode and story mode! Time-consuming to evolve, however, if you don't have [[Hanje (Captain)]] and need a good physical hill, Hawks is a good candidate!
<br>

'''Per-Unit (single) DPS is usually what most people in the community talk about as calculations are easier without taking into account number of placement. Please keep in mind that while certain characters' singular DPS may be higher than others, placement limits affect Total DPS significantly. The approximate range for DPS (PER SINGLE UNIT) descriptions are:'''

*Bad DPS 1,000-2000
*Moderate DPS 2,001-3,000
*Good DPS 3,001-4000
*High DPS 4,001-5,000
*Great DPS 5,001-6,000
*Amazing DPS 6,001-7,000
*Massive DPS 7,001-8,000
*Insane DPS 8,001-9,000
*Colossal DPS 9,001-10,000
*Ultimate DPS 10,001-25,000
*Godly DPS 25,001-30,000+

'''DPS accounts for the DMG (Damage) of a unit divided by its SPA (Attack Speed). The Total damage of a unit can be higher or lower as some units can only be placed 3, 4, 5, etc. amount times.'''<br><center class="mobileonly">{{Anchor1|text=⮝ back start|id=back}}</center>
